name: DanZmale
author: Eduptal
description: Drop between the invisible portals and saw at 73% as the mini ship. Then fly above the second set of invisible portals, keeping below the big saw. For the technique, I recommend one swoop after the first invisible portals to go above the second set (rather than spamming straight flying). You can drop to the floor at 76%. Free to the end from there. NOTE: you may emerge as the big ship instead of mini - that's fine.
